rows.grounds: fused form of piṣṭacūrṇaiḥ (instrumental plural of piṣṭacūrṇa, flour-powder) and alaṃ (indeclinable, sufficiently); sandhi r + a
absolutive of root kṛ, indicating a prior completed action
object of the final imperative; ritual benediction declaring an auspicious day
object of the final imperative; ritual act of sprinkling consecrated water
imperative command addressed to the officiant

items.question: Which preparatory ritual acts must the officiant perform after adorning the altar?
premises: The altar is to be sufficiently adorned with flour powders.
Adorning with flour powders is completed before subsequent acts.
The auspicious-day rite and sprinkling are commanded as ritual actions.
items.inference: After adorning the altar with flour powders, the officiant must perform the auspicious-day rite and the sprinkling.
uncertainties: The exact scope of alaṃ in this ritual context may indicate either sufficiency or ornamentation.
items.plain_english: Having sufficiently adorned it with flour powders, perform the auspicious-day rite and the sprinkling.
